## Downloads

| File                               | For                                                                                                   |
|------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `xxmi_toolbox-{version}.zip`        | Blender 4.2 and newer: Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > Install from Disk, or drag it into Blender |
| `xxmi_toolbox-{version}-legacy.zip` | Blender 3.6: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install                                                   |

The "Source code" archives are GitHub's own and can't be installed.

The **Toolbox** panel appears in the sidebar tab of XXMI Tools, WWMI Tools or EFMI Tools, so one of them needs to be
installed.

## Updates

XXMI Toolbox can check for new releases and install them from its **Updater** section (in the Toolbox panel and the
add-on preferences); restart Blender afterwards. On Blender 4.2 and newer, turn on **Allow Online Access** in
Edit > Preferences > System first, or it won't connect.
